# YT SEO Architect
> 17 AI-powered tools that automate YouTube SEO — competing with vidIQ and TubeBuddy.

## Overview
YT SEO Architect is a comprehensive YouTube SEO optimization platform for creators of all sizes. Built for the 2026 YouTube algorithm, it focuses on discoverability, session watch time, and niche authority.

## Key Features
- **AI Coach**: Data-driven YouTube strategy with your real channel metrics
- **Bulk Injector**: One-click SEO overhaul for entire playlists
- **Retention Re-Orderer**: Gateway strategy playlist sorting
- **AI Auto-Responder**: Fetch comments → AI generates reply → posts to YouTube
- **Playlist Growth Suite**: Weaver, Collusion Tags, Session Linker
- **17 tools total**: Keyword Discovery, Thumbnail Lab, Competitor Sniper, Script-to-Shorts, Chapters Generator, Trend Pulse, Evergreen Audit, Multi-Language SEO, Video Factory, Metadata Auditor, AI Content Label

## How It Works
1. Connect your YouTube channel via Google OAuth
2. AI analyzes your videos, playlists, and performance data
3. Apply optimizations with one click directly to YouTube
4. Monitor growth through the dashboard

## Pricing
- **Free**: 100 credits to start, no credit card required
- **Pro**: $5/month — 1,000 credits, premium features
- **Agency**: $19/month — unlimited credits, all features

## Technical Details
- **AI**: Groq (primary) + Google Gemini (automatic failover)
- **Security**: OAuth 2.0, CSRF protection, Helmet headers, atomic credit transactions
- **Infrastructure**: Vercel + Neon PostgreSQL
- **Domain**: https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app
